Both mechanisms are verifiable in the added catch block (`packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts` ~line 755-762 in the diff). Info leakage on a public API is a genuine defect introduced by this change.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts`, `loadUsers` was changed to wrap the user-loading logic in a `try/catch` and explicitly rethrow `Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError` (and `HttpError`) as `new HttpError({ statusCode: 400, message: error.message })`. This forwards the raw Prisma `error.message` into a public-facing 400 response, which can expose internal DB/ORM details. For non-Prisma/non-Http errors it throws a generic 500 `"Unable to load users"` without any logging in this catch block, reducing diagnosability and altering error behavior compared to letting the original error propagate. These behaviors are directly visible in the added `catch` logic in the diff.
